name: set_texture_render_mode
description: Set how a texture renders: render_mode ('default' | 'emissive' = full-bright, ignores light | 'additive' = bright pixels add light & dark vanishes, best for fire/energy on planes | 'layered' | 'normal' | 'height' | 'mer'), render_sides ('auto' | 'front' | 'double' for 2-sided planes), flipbook frame timing, and particle flag. Use this to make VFX glow and to show planes from both sides.

texture.description: uuid or name of the texture.
